title: FlowAnchor: Inversion-Free Stable Video Editing
summary: FlowAnchor is a training-free and inversion-free video editing framework designed for high-quality video-to-video transformations. It utilizes spatial-aware attention refinement and adaptive magnitude modulation to ensure temporal consistency and precise editing signals.
research_notes: The framework specifically targets challenges in multi-object and fast-motion scenarios where traditional inversion-based methods often fail or lack efficiency.

evolution.summary: Officially released in April 2026; established as a state-of-the-art training-free method that improves upon the Wan-Edit baseline by solving signal bleeding and fading issues. It follows previous research by CUC-MIPG including Edit-Transfer and IC-Effect.
